good afternoon chair vice chair I guess and members BILL would expand access to safer consumer loans by raising the upper limit of loans available under the pilot program for increased access to responsible small dollar loans to $7500

currently many unbanked and underserved communities lack access to affordable credit through traditional financial institutions such as banks or credit unions instead when you walk through communities like mine you see payday lenders auto title loan lenders and other lenders that offer loans with triple digit interest rates on every corner of every block
